svg.title: Where Hainan gibbons live
svg.desc: A simplified map of Hainan Island, off the southern coast of China across the Qiongzhou Strait. Every Hainan gibbon alive lives in about 16 square kilometres of rainforest in the Bawangling area in the west of the island, now part of Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park. There are about 42 gibbons in seven family groups, up from thirteen found in 2003.

text.font-family: Georgia, serif
-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One patch of rainforest on one island. About 16 square kilometres, in total.
